title: Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit — Refill Override Rules for Member Services
content:
**Rule.** An override under the Retail Pharmacy Network Benefit lets a network pharmacy fill one prescription past the refill-too-soon edit or, for an emergency supply, before a pending coverage review is decided. Each override is recorded against one prescription number and drug.

## Kinds of override

1. **Vacation supply.** A vacation supply may be granted no earlier than the network's vacation lead time in calendar days before the departure date the member gives, for up to the network's maximum vacation days supply, and at most the network's number of vacation overrides per drug per plan year. Vacation supplies are never granted for controlled substances. The lead time counts back from the departure date, the departure date being day zero, and the departure date is taken as the member states it.
2. **Lost, stolen or damaged medication.** A replacement is granted at most the network's number of lost or stolen overrides per drug per plan year. For a controlled substance it is granted only on a network that allows a lost or stolen controlled substance to be replaced and, where the network requires a police report, only with the member's police report number.
3. **Dose change.** A dose-change override is granted on a network that allows one, when the new prescription at the higher dose is on file.

## Validity and status

- Each override is valid through the seventh calendar day after it is granted, the grant date being day zero: an override granted on day 0 may be used by the pharmacy through day 7.
- An override may be granted only while the retail benefit is active or locked in, as the retail benefit's status on record shows.
- A locked-in member's override for a controlled substance is valid only at the lock-in pharmacy.

## Counting the per-year limits

The overrides counted are those on this retail benefit for the same drug and the same kind of override, granted in the current plan year — from the plan year start date of the member's Pharmacy Benefit Plan enrollment through today.

## Who supplies what

| Fact | Where it comes from |
|---|---|
| Benefit status | The retail benefit's status on record |
| Departure date of a trip | The member's statement |
| Police report number | The member |
| Overrides already granted | The overrides on record for the benefit |

## Lead-time boundary (hypothetical dates)

On a network whose vacation lead time is 14 days, a member gives a departure date. A vacation supply may be granted on the 14th calendar day before that date or on any later day; on the 15th calendar day before it, the grant would be earlier than the lead time allows.

## Retired clause — no longer in force

The clause "An emergency supply of the network's emergency supply days is granted only while a coverage review for that drug is pending, at most the network's number of emergency supply overrides per drug per plan year" is no longer in force; it has been superseded by the current basis.

superseded_clauses: An emergency supply of emergency_supply_days days is granted only while a coverage review for that drug is pending, at most emergency_supply_per_drug_per_year times per drug per plan year.
